body.statement: The fortified pairing has generic full row rank if and only if \(\kappa_0(S)=0\) and \(\dim_{\mathbb F_S}(\sum_{(y,j)\in I}W_y)\ge|I|\) for every \(I\subseteq\mathcal D_S\). Equivalently, generic full row rank holds if and only if \(\kappa_0(S)=0\) and \(\eta(S)=0\). Failure of either condition is a law-uniform failure of this pairing route, not a claim that \(\tau\) is unidentified.
body.justification: The all-subfamilies inequalities are the exact structural-support frontier rather than a global supply-versus-demand count.
body.gap: Published proximal rank conditions are law-level conditions, and generic partitioned-matrix theorems allow different parameter dependence than the stochastic product blocks here.
body.consumer: The frontier gives a deficient subset of treatment-by-complement blocks that explains why an apparently adequate aggregate alphabet cannot support fortified completeness.
